semiconductor_relevance: High — Japan Electronic Materials Corporation specializes in probe cards and related testing equipment for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Japan Electronic Materials Corporation (JEM) is a leading provider of probe cards and testing solutions for semiconductor devices, with a focus on advanced logic and memory applications. Their products include MEMS-type probe cards designed for high-density memory and logic devices, ensuring high performance and reliability in testing.
capabilities: High density vertical contact probe cards (MC)
MEMS-type probe cards for advanced logic devices
New probe materials for Memory and Logic devices

regional_presence.Taiwan: JEM Taiwan Probe Corp. is a subsidiary of Japan Electronic Materials Corp., focusing on probe card production and advanced technical services.
